Kim / Marcus — reviewed and attached redline notes. Summary:

- Proration: Acceptable as an Exhibit‑level billing carve‑out. I added language to Section 5.1 (Billing) that specifies proration applies to added capacity reflected in the Order Form Exhibit B effective mid‑term. This avoids an MSA amendment.
- Timelock: We can add a 60‑day price‑change timelock to the Order Form as an express amendment. Draft clause added to the order‑form redline ("Price Stability Period"). Note that we treat timelocks as bilateral commitments — if Lumina requests a mid‑term capacity reduction, normal termination/adjustment language still applies.
- Exhibit B / Burst handling: Redlined the burst definition to reference a concrete threshold (e.g., sustained >1.2x baseline for >10 minutes triggers burst billing) and added an example table so the customer can see practical behavior. Also added an explicit fallback to our published burst policy to avoid ambiguity.

I also flagged two items that may require Exec approval (please route if needed):
1) A one‑time onboarding credit request for the extra capacity ramp (Lumina asked about a partial credit).
2) A request to lock list pricing for 18 months instead of 12 (they only asked for 60 days, but procurement mentioned "would they accept 18 months?" in a thread).

Attachments: Lumina_Redline_Notes.pdf (annotated PDF with inline comments)

If you want, I can draft the final clean order form and an amendment letter that references the order form redline; keep me in the loop for the DocuSign routing.
